I purchased this product about a couple weeks to a month ago to add to my routine. I absolutly love it, and recommend it to anyone trying to get rid of acne.

This is one of my HG products. I'm halfway through my second bottle now. I apply this morning and night first thing after cleansing. It feels gently moisturizing. My skin seems to get extremely oily with hormonal fluctuations, and this genuinely helps reduce the oiliness without drying me out at all. It works incredibly well under makeup and sunscreen — no pilling whatsoever!! It also doesnt cause my skin to peel, get flaky, or feel dry and tight, which were common issues I've had with other products that claim to reduce oiliness. In my 30s, I have had new ongoing issues with acne along my jaw and chin. This is the only product that's helped reduce that issue completely when I use it consistently morning and night. Only a few drops are needed for my face (don't need a whole droppers' worth). About that smell….I have an incredibly sensitive nose. It's unfortunately true that this product smells bad. It is not rancid, it just smells that way. I apply this product to my face, let it dry down for a minute or two, and then put my moisturizer on top. The odor dissipates a few minutes later after it dries/my skin absorbs the product, usually in less than 15 minutes. This serum works so well for me that I don't mind dealing with the odor. It's truly not that bad for my sensitive nose, but your mileage may vary with your own smell sensitivity. I love this product and will continue to use it.

I received a bottle of The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. It came in well packed and is already in a dropper bottle, making it easier to apply. This multiactive transparent solution is a mixture of fragmented molecules derived from the breakdown of bacteria lactococcus lactis. It helps minimize excess shine and reduce pores, while it hydrates and strengthen your skin barrier. This is fragrance free and is great for people with blemish prone skin. It's so easy to apply. After cleansing, put few drops on your face avoiding eyes. It is non greasy. It hydrates the skin well. It also helps improve your skin texture, giving you brighter, clearer, and fresher skin. I love this serum.

I also noticed that my skin appeared dryer after cleansing. Did nothing for texture or pores. I would skip this product.
This product is as good as all of The Ordinary products, really effective. The texture is very liquid so your skin absorbed it really well. Good ingredients.

avis.titre: Luxury skin care at affordable prices
avis.texte: Using this product feels like getting a facial at a spa. The scent is pleasing and it helps my face feel fully hydrated. Packaging is standard (I haven't mastered using the dropper yet).

I've incorporated The Ordinary's serum into my daily routine, and it's been a game-changer. The packaging is sleek and functional, no-nonsense and efficient. As for the scent, it's almost undetectable, which I appreciate – it lets the results speak for themselves. It's become an indispensable ally for my skin, keeping it balanced and at ease.

This is a great product for oily and combo skin. I have combo skin so when I get acne, I'm always worried about products drying out my skin. This product is nice and does not dry out my skin while treating the areas of acne. I use it when I have a breakout and it helps reduce the length of my breakout.

I often feel as though I have a somewhat shiny and pore-ridden face, so this product seemed like a pretty safe bet, reinforced by the fact that I implicitly trust pretty much anything from The Ordinary. This stuff is good too! I'm easy though, and haven't gotten a product I hate from the brand thus far; it does feel as though my pores are more manageable, and it's tough to tell if my skin has a more matte look yet, but the product does seem to be working for me. Everyone is different with things like this, The Ordinary is pretty much always one of the more affordable options, so I'd recommend it's worth a try!

The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum has significantly enhanced my skincare regimen. Its lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and balanced. I have observed a notable reduction in breakouts and an overall improvement in my complexion. The serum is both gentle and effective, making it ideal for daily use. For those seeking an affordable and effective solution for clear, healthy skin, I highly recommend The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum. Five stars.

avis.titre: Multiple benefits in a single bottle
avis.texte: The Ordinary never disappoints. Every time I try a product from them, I am totally delighted. This facial serum is wonderful. It should be applied after cleansing the face, to help, among other things, minimize excess shine on the face, balance oil and water in the skin, and show off smoother skin with fewer acne marks. The bottle is UV Protecting Packaging, that's awesome! And the serum combines 7 different ingredients to get the best results on the face skin. It's a really good addition in your skincare routine.

The balancing and clarifying serum by The Ordinary is an awesome new serum. It has a myriad of new ingredients, some I have seen before and some I have no experience with, and I like it. From what I can tell, they use a mix of peptides/amino acids and a gentle enzyme to provide an all-encompassing type of serum. It has benefits ranging from oil reduction to exfoliation to hydration. I have combination skin, and so far, in the days I have used this serum, I have noticed very even skin that doesn't get too oily by the end of the day and seems to be happily hydrated and breakout-free. I highly recommend this serum; as always, since it is by The Ordinary, this product is great value.

I used this to treat some problem areas on my face and it worked over night. My daughter tried it on some stubborn spots on her shoulder and she found clearer skin very quickly. I am impressed with the product and I have purchased skin treatments from the ordinary before and have never been disappointed. They have another winner here.

The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum is a standout addition to any skincare routine. Its lightweight formula quickly absorbs, providing immediate hydration without a greasy residue. This serum effectively balances oil production and reduces blemishes, thanks to its potent blend of salicylic acid and niacinamide. Ideal for those with combination or acne-prone skin, it leaves the complexion smoother and more refined. The fragrance-free, cruelty-free formulation is also gentle on sensitive skin. Affordable yet highly effective, this serum offers visible improvements in skin clarity and texture, making it a must-have for achieving a balanced, clearer complexion.

It absorbs quickly, and layers well on top of other serums/toners + under more occlusive products like moisturizer and sunscreen. All in all an excellent value given the price point.

I recently incorporated The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum into my skincare routine, and I am thoroughly impressed with the results. As someone who struggles with combination skin and occasional breakouts, finding a product that effectively balances and clarifies my complexion has been a game-changer. One of the first things I noticed about this serum is its lightweight texture. It absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy or sticky residue, making it perfect for both morning and evening use. This is especially important for me, as I like to layer my skincare products without feeling weighed down. The formulation of this serum is impressive. It includes key ingredients like niacinamide and zinc, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and oil-regulating properties. After just a few weeks of consistent use, I've noticed a significant reduction in the frequency and severity of my breakouts. Another benefit of this serum is its ability to improve skin texture. My complexion feels smoother and more even, with a noticeable reduction in redness and blotchiness. It has also helped to minimize the appearance of my pores, giving my skin a more refined and polished look. The packaging is simple and functional. The dropper bottle allows for precise application, ensuring that I use just the right amount of product each time. A little goes a long way, so the serum lasts quite a while, making it a great value for the price. One of the standout features of The Or

avis.titre: A Clear Solution for Troubled Skin
avis.texte: I recently started using a balancing and clarifying serum aimed at improving skin texture and clarity, and I must say, it's become a crucial part of my skincare routine. This serum targets excess oil and blemishes, which has been a persistent issue for me. The lightweight formula is one of its best features. It absorbs into the skin quickly without leaving a greasy residue, making it perfect for use under makeup or as a stand-alone treatment. I've noticed a significant reduction in shine throughout the day, and my complexion appears more balanced and less prone to breakouts. The serum also includes ingredients that help to soothe and calm the skin, which has been great for reducing redness and irritation associated with acne. The subtle, fresh scent is refreshing and not overpowering, which I appreciate in skincare products. However, those with extremely dry skin might find it a bit too mattifying. It's ideal for combination to oily skin types, particularly those dealing with acne or general skin congestion. Overall, this balancing and clarifying serum has been effective in controlling oil, reducing blemishes, and leaving my skin looking healthier and more even-toned. It's a fantastic choice for anyone looking to tackle these specific skin concerns with a gentle yet effective product.

avis.titre: It's not the best serum I've used.
avis.texte: I received The Ordinary Balancing and Clarifying Serum free in return for my honest review. I was excited to see if this serum could help manage my oily skin and minimize pores. Starting with its effectiveness, I found the results to be mixed. It does a decent job of reducing excess shine and keeping my skin less oily throughout the day. However, I didn't see a significant difference in my enlarged pores or post-acne marks. My skin felt hydrated, but I didn't notice a major improvement in radiance or overall clarity. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which I appreciated. It's easy to layer with other products in my routine without feeling heavy or greasy. However, it left a slightly tacky feeling on my skin, which wasn't my favorite. The scent is very mild, almost non-existent, which is great if you're sensitive to strong fragrances. I prefer products that don't have overpowering scents, so this was a plus for me. The packaging is simple and functional. It comes in a small dropper bottle, making it easy to control the amount you use. However, the bottle feels a bit flimsy and could be more durable, especially if you're like me and tend to be a bit clumsy during busy mornings. When it comes to ingredients, The Ordinary always impresses with their straightforward and effective formulations. What sets this serum apart is its versatility. It's suitable for all skin types, including oily, combination, and sensitive skin. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any residue, making it ideal for layering with other skincare products. Users have reported significant improvements in their skin's condition after incorporating this serum into their routine. From reduced breakouts to a more even skin tone, the results speak for themselves. With consistent use, many have regained confidence in their skin's appearance. Another aspect to commend is The Ordinary's commitment to transparency and affordability. As with all of their products, the Balancing and Clarifying Serum is priced accessibly without compromising on quality.
